Descriptor bytes describe successful logical coverage, including a descriptor that later fails an expected-hash comparison. Failure before descriptor return has unknown byte coverage. Repeated reads are retained; unique descriptors use lexical path, size and content hash without an extra stat/resolve. No physical I/O, CPU wait or speedup is inferred.

load.interpretation: Whole-verifier context only. System CPU is interval utilization across logical CPUs including this benchmark; process cpu_core_percent is relative to one logical CPU and may exceed 100. The first CPU observation is excluded. Cumulative disk deltas cover only adjacent valid samples. PID/create_time changes, unavailable processes and counter resets are never bridged or filled with zero. Nominal 200ms polling includes acquisition and scheduling gaps; missing-periodic counts estimate skipped nominal slots. No per-query interpolation, process-specific slowdown causality, Ollama token speed or optimization claim follows. Observer work remains part of this measured environment.
